title: 4 Ingredient Cilantro Lime Rice
summary: Bright lime juice, fluffy rice, and fresh cilantro turn this 4 ingredient cilantro lime rice into one of the easiest side dishes I make during busy weeks. I toss everything into the rice cooker and in…
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice (brown, basmati, or white rice, use frozen rice for fast and easy option)
¼ - ¾ teaspoon sea salt (see note)
steps: Combine rice, water, and lime juice in your rice cooker, and cook following your rice cooker's instructions.
Once cooked, remove lid and mix in sea salt and chopped cilantro.
Serve alone or as part of a meal!
author: Anjali Shah
